note.zh-TW: 直譯自日文的販売費及び一般管理費；保留「銷管費用」為主要顯示，別名「營業費用」。台灣報表按功能別分成推銷、管理、研究發展三類。
note.en: A direct translation of the Japanese selling, general and administrative expenses; the course wording stays as the main display with operating expenses as an alias. Taiwanese statements split it by function into distribution, administrative and research and development.

definition.zh-TW: 做生意時除了進貨成本以外的日常開支，例如董監事酬勞、運費與折舊。它是模板的分組標題，不可入帳。
definition.en: The everyday costs of running the business other than the cost of goods, such as directors' pay, delivery and depreciation. A template group heading that cannot be posted to.
